About us

Three generations.It started with pepperoni.

In 1954, Giuseppe “Joe” and Raymond “Ray” Teolis began delivering fresh pepperoni to neighbourhood pizzerias. Those early customers helped shape the business that became Les Aliments Joe & Ray.

As their customers’ kitchens grew, so did the selection. Today we supply restaurants, caterers and retailers with deli meats, imported cheeses and Italian specialties.

Our third generation carries on the work in Saint-Léonard, with the same care for the products we carry and the people who serve them.

Services

Tailored solutions for the food industry.

  • Food distribution

    Delivering a diverse range of over 2,000 products, including local and imported deli meats, cheeses, and essential kitchen supplies.

  • Custom product sourcing

    We work closely with suppliers to provide unique and specialty items tailored to your menu needs.

  • Food safety & compliance

    With a CFIA-approved import license, recall programs and product arrival controls, we make sure every product meets the highest safety standards.

  • Logistics & warehousing solutions

    We offer streamlined storage and distribution services to keep your business running smoothly.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Find answers to common questions about our products and services.

Can’t find your answer? Call us. 514.729.6470

What areas do you serve?

We distribute throughout Quebec and surrounding areas.

How do I become a customer?

Fill out the contact form below or call us at 514.729.6470. We’ll set up your account and pricing.

What is your minimum order?

$500 for local deliveries.

What are your delivery times?

Delivery times vary based on location. Call us at 514.729.6470 and we’ll confirm the schedule for your area.

Can I set up recurring orders?

Yes. We offer recurring deliveries on the schedule that suits your kitchen.

Can I place a custom order?

Yes. We work with our suppliers to source specialty products for your business.

What products do you specialize in?

Deli meats, cheeses and imported specialty foods, mostly Italian.

Do you carry sanitation and paper products?

Yes, a wide range of cleaning, packaging and paper products for food businesses.

Do you offer food safety programs?

Yes. We hold a CFIA import licence and run food safety and product recall programs.

Are your products locally sourced?

We carry a mix of local and imported products to fit your needs.
